It's the kind of incentive design that you can use to build many other things on the internet (which itself is driven by very simple core protocols and could even upgrade itself as a result).. key_points.text: It's the kind of incentive design that you can use to build many other things on the internet (which itself is driven by very simple core protocols and could even upgrade itself as a result)..
Which is where cryptonetworks come in -- especially since they don't rely on hardware buildout (as with earlier generations of internet deployment).
